Hi Alex / Priya,

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion, attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan focused on the POC environment setup dependencies you flagged (VPC peering, IP allowlists, SSO/SAML, and secrets/KMS).

Key asks in this draft:
- Confirm who owns VPC peering on your side (network team contact).
- Provide the public egress IP ranges or the allowlist CIDRs for your environment.
- Confirm SSO provider details (IdP metadata) and whether you prefer SP-initiated or IdP-initiated flows.
- Confirm KMS/secret management approach (customer-managed KMS vs Redwood-managed secrets).

I’ve put target owners and estimated lead times in the doc. High-level milestone view below:

1) Network & Connectivity (VPC peering, routes, allowlists) — owner: Acme network, target completion: 2 weeks after kickoff
2) Identity (SSO/SAML integration + test user) — owner: Acme SSO, target completion: 1 week after idp metadata
3) Secrets & KMS (key access, rotation) — owner: Acme security, target completion: 1 week after KMS access
4) Final smoke tests & telemetry access — owner: Redwood / Acme joint, target completion: 2 business days

Attachments: ACME_MAP_Draft_v2.pdf, network_config_template.yaml (sample routes and firewall rules).

Next step: can we schedule a 30-min tech check with your network/security folks next week? Nikhil (cc'd) can run the checklist.

Thanks,

Thanks Marissa — doc looks good. A few clarifying notes from our side before we loop in network/security:

- VPC peering: our network lead (cc'd: it@acme.com) owns the peering. They will need the peer CIDR and a small maintenance window to validate routes.
- IP allowlists: we do not have static egress IPs for our cloud account by default. Can Redwood support both (a) IP allowlist using static egress from a NAT gateway we control, or (b) mutual TLS as a fallback?
- SSO: we are Ok with SAML. We use Okta; I can share IdP metadata but need to confirm whether Redwood requires SP-initiated.
- KMS: we are leaning toward customer-managed KMS (Cloud KMS) for the POC. We will need guidance on granting the Redwood service principal the decrypt/encrypt permission scoped to the POC key.

We can do the tech check next Wednesday morning PST. Does 10am work for Nikhil?

-Alex

Subject: Re: MAP: POC environment setup — initial draft

Hi Alex / Priya — thanks for the quick read. I'm Nikhil (solutions eng) — happy to run the tech check. Some quick answers and requests to make the Wednesday call efficient:

1) Connectivity options: Redwood supports both IP allowlisting (static egress) and mTLS-based authentication. For IP allowlist, we prefer you provide the CIDRs for your firewall; for NAT egress we'll provide the outbound IP range from our shared nat (if using Redwood-managed infra) or accept your NAT IPs for allowlist.

2) SP vs IdP-initiated SAML: SP-initiated is standard for our integration; we can support IdP-initiated for the POC but will need to exchange metadata and a test user to validate attributes (email, name, groups).

3) KMS: Customer-managed KMS works. We'll need a service account/service principal for Redwood with the following permissions on the key: encrypt, decrypt, get, and (optional) rotate. If you prefer, we can accept a wrapped secret upload into Redwood's secret store — either way works for the POC.

4) Suggested owner/responsibility updates for the MAP (I'll update the doc after your confirmation):
   - Network & Connectivity: Owner = Acme IT (it@acme.com) — deliverables: peer CIDR, maintenance window, firewall rules
   - Identity: Owner = Acme SSO (Priya) — deliverables: IdP metadata, test user + group mapping doc
   - Secrets/KMS: Owner = Acme Security (Alex) — deliverables: service principal details OR wrapped secret, KMS key ARN
   - Redwood tasks: provide peer endpoint, outbound IPs (if Redwood-managed), SAML SP metadata, test playbook for smoke tests

5) Please confirm whether you want Redwood-managed ephemeral KMS or customer-managed KMS for the POC — we'll add the chosen path to the MAP and milestone timelines.

I'm available Wed 10:00am PST. Marissa, can you send a calendar invite and attach the updated MAP after we decide on owners?

Thanks,
Nikhil Sharma
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai
